references.text: Jesus continues his teaching and healing in the towns and villages, which reflects his ministry in Galilee described in Matthew 4:23.
Luke describes how Jesus taught in the synagogues of Galilee, similar to the description of his ministry in Matthew 4:23.
Jesus expresses his mission to preach the kingdom of God, consistent with his preaching and healing mentioned in Matthew 4:23.
John notes that Jesus was well received in Galilee, which can be related to his extensive ministry there, including the elements mentioned in Matthew 4:23.
The prophet Isaiah foretells one who will proclaim good news and heal, foreshadowing Jesus' ministry described in Matthew 4:23.
Micah prophesies about light for those living in darkness in Galilee, which can be seen as a prediction of Jesus' ministry in this region, as described in Matthew 4:23.
